# LLM-Summarize-BERTopic

**Topic Modeling Enhancement using Summaries Generated by LLM Models**

Published in the Proceedings of the International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Computer, Data Sciences and Applications (ACDSA 2025), Antalya, Turkey, August 2025. IEEE Xplore.

- Paper: https://doi.org/10.1109/acdsa65407.2025.11166276
- Authors: Haya El Ghalayini, Min Liu, Bhagyesh Patel, Hetkumar Patel, Rasheed Amanzai (Sheridan College)

## The idea

Topic models struggle with long, unstructured documents: topics overlap, and long texts have to be chopped up before a model like BERTopic can use them. This research asks whether an LLM can do that preparation better.

## Two approaches compared

| | Method 1: paragraphs | Method 2: LLM summaries |
|---|---|---|
| prepare | split each document into paragraphs | an LLM splits the document into token segments and summarizes each one |
| model | BERTopic on the paragraphs | BERTopic on the summaries |

## Result

Summarizing the documents with an LLM first, then running BERTopic on the summaries, performed better than running BERTopic on paragraphs. See the paper for the datasets, metrics and full results.
